name: billiboi-session-board

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: Shows every Claude Code session on this machine (status, current task, todo progress) in a band above the prompt or a side pane. Read-only.

plugins.name: peer-status-writer
plugins.description: Writes this session's TodoWrite/TaskCreate/TaskUpdate items to ~/.claude/peer-status/<sessionId>.json so session-board can show them.

plugins.name: message-board
plugins.description: Timeline of cross-session messages (sent, received, and the user's own prompts) across every session that has it on.

plugins.name: notion-board
plugins.description: Shows a Notion database (e.g. an issue tracker) as a table above the prompt or in a pane and refreshes it periodically. Read-only.

description: Mods for working with several Claude Code sessions at once: a session board, a message timeline, and a status writer.
